description: The verified dev loop with ZERO bookkeeping: the preview service already retains the previous generation of every screen's tree, so this diffs a screen's LAST render against its CURRENT one — no pre-edit snapshot needed. Returns { changes, regressions:{drift, driftChecked, a11y}, verdict: 'proven-clean' | 'changed-with-regressions' | 'no-change' } (drift is checked against the previews dir's design-system.json when present). Typical loop: edit → preview_status{waitForRender:true} → preview_diff{screen:<a changed id>}. For a baseline that must survive sessions, the lane's golden trees (qa/golden/, UPDATE_GOLDEN=1) are the durable regression layer.
name: preview_diff
title: Diff a screen across the last two renders (one-call verified edit)
